title: Hearty Woodfired American Chicken Liver Bake
description: A yeasty, aerated, solo-dinner American dish featuring chicken liver, wood-fired-bake, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, cooked in an iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together yeast, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the chicken liver to the bowl and mix until the liver is fully coated with the yeast and spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in the iron teppan vessel over medium heat.
Add the chicken liver mixture to the teppan vessel and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Transfer the teppan vessel to the preheated wood-fired oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the teppan vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
